blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Thursday that 85.24 percent passed the licensure examination for chemical engineers. According to the PRC, 814 out of 955 examinees successfully passed the November 2026 Chemical Engineer Licensure Examination.
